statements.text: The pause screen offers Resume, Options and Leave the run, and the camp can still be seen around or behind it.
The camp on a phone shows something to tap that pauses the game.
Changing music volume, sound volume or message speed calls `setOption` as the value changes, not only when the pause screen closes.
Leave the run asks the player first, and `leaveRun` is only called after they agree.
While the pause screen is open, keys don't reach the camp underneath: arrow keys and Enter move or choose nothing on the camp.
statements.note: camp.tsx, unchanged by the task, handles arrow keys and Enter in a `keydown` listener on `window`. A pause screen opened on top does not stop that listener on its own; the diff has to switch it off while paused or stop the events before they get there.
